quests.question: ___ fresh basil wasn't available, the chef used dried herbs instead.
quests.hint: This introduces a reason, similar to 'because', in more formal writing.
quests.explanation: 'As' introduces a reason here — the missing basil explains the substitution.

quests.question: This recipe uses butter, ___ the vegan version uses coconut oil instead.
quests.hint: Two versions of the same dish are being compared.
quests.explanation: 'While' contrasts two related facts — two versions of the recipe use different fats.

quests.question: She seasoned the steak ___ let it rest for ten minutes before slicing.
quests.hint: Two cooking steps happen right after each other.
quests.explanation: 'And' links two consecutive steps in a recipe — seasoning and resting.

quests.question: The ending felt rushed, ___ the rest of the film was beautifully paced.
quests.hint: One flaw is acknowledged, but the overall quality still stands.
quests.explanation: 'Though' introduces a concession — a rushed ending didn't ruin an otherwise well-paced film.

quests.question: No sooner had the band walked on stage ___ the whole crowd started screaming.
quests.hint: This fixed expression always pairs 'no sooner' with one specific word — not 'when'.
quests.explanation: 'No sooner...than' is a fixed pair for one event immediately followed by another.

quests.question: Tickets are refundable ___ the venue changed the show's date.
quests.hint: A schedule change explains the refund policy.
quests.explanation: 'Because' gives the direct reason for a policy — the changed date led to refunds being offered.

quests.question: ___ the prices were higher than usual, the shop was still crowded with holiday shoppers.
quests.hint: Notice that a full subject-verb clause comes right after the blank.
quests.explanation: 'Although' introduces a full clause here — 'despite' would instead need a noun phrase, like 'despite the higher prices'.

quests.question: Online orders won't ship ___ payment has been fully confirmed.
quests.hint: Confirmed payment is the one requirement for shipping.
quests.explanation: 'Unless' means 'except if' — shipping depends entirely on this one condition.

quests.question: The size chart was confusing, ___ I ordered two sizes to compare.
quests.hint: Confusion directly led to a practical solution.
quests.explanation: 'So' introduces a result — the confusing chart led to ordering two sizes.

quests.question: I still haven't decided ___ to buy the sofa online ___ visit the showroom first.
quests.hint: Two shopping approaches are both still being considered.
quests.explanation: 'Whether...or' introduces two options under consideration — buying online or visiting in person.

quests.question: The launch was delayed ___ the final testing revealed a serious bug.
quests.hint: A specific discovery explains the delay.
quests.explanation: 'Because' gives the direct reason for the delay — the bug found during testing.

quests.question: The presentation had a few technical hiccups, ___ the client loved the final proposal.
quests.hint: A rough start didn't spoil the overall outcome.
quests.explanation: 'But' introduces a contrast — technical problems didn't prevent a positive result.

quests.question: The app sends an alert ___ suspicious activity is detected on your account.
quests.hint: The alert follows detection immediately, without delay.
quests.explanation: 'As soon as' means immediately after — the alert follows detection without delay.

quests.question: The team added two-factor authentication ___ accounts would be harder to hack.
quests.hint: Adding this feature has one clear, intended purpose.
quests.explanation: 'So that' introduces a purpose — the feature was added to improve account security.

quests.question: The old system stored data locally, ___ the new one relies on the cloud.
quests.hint: Two systems are being compared, each with a different approach.
quests.explanation: 'While' contrasts two related facts — two systems that store data differently.

quests.question: ___ the waiting room was completely full, the clinic called in extra staff.
quests.hint: This introduces a reason, similar to 'because'.
quests.explanation: 'As' introduces a reason here — the crowded waiting room explains the extra staff.

quests.question: ___ the ambulance arrived, the paramedics had already been briefed by phone.
quests.hint: One event had already happened before the other one occurred.
quests.explanation: 'By the time' shows the briefing had already happened before the ambulance's arrival.

quests.question: You can book the appointment online, ___ you can call the clinic directly.
quests.hint: Two booking methods are offered — only one is needed.
quests.explanation: 'Or' presents two alternatives — either method of booking works.

quests.question: The old cinema will close permanently ___ enough donations come in this month.
quests.hint: Reaching a donation goal is the one thing that could change the outcome.
quests.explanation: 'Unless' means 'except if' — staying open depends entirely on this one condition.

quests.question: The renovation took longer than planned, ___ the final result impressed everyone.
quests.hint: A delay is acknowledged, but the outcome still turned out well.
quests.explanation: 'Though' introduces a concession — a long renovation still ended with an impressive result.

quests.question: Volunteers cleared the trail ___ repainted all the trail markers over the weekend.
quests.hint: Two community tasks were completed during the same event.
quests.explanation: 'And' links two tasks completed together — clearing the trail and repainting markers.

quests.question: The new schedule is not only easier for the kids ___ also less stressful for parents.
quests.hint: 'Not only' always pairs with one word to add a second benefit.
quests.explanation: 'Not only...but also' adds a second benefit to the first — easier for kids and less stressful for parents.

quests.question: ___ my sister started working night shifts, we rarely see each other during the week.
quests.hint: This word can introduce a reason, not just a point in time.
quests.explanation: 'Since' can mean 'because' here — the night shifts explain why they rarely meet.

quests.question: The kids can watch one more episode ___ they get ready for bed first.
quests.hint: Getting ready first is the specific condition attached to the extra episode.
quests.explanation: 'As long as' means 'on the condition that' — the extra episode depends on this one requirement.

quests.question: ___ the security line moved very slowly, we still made it to the gate on time.
quests.hint: The words after the blank form a complete clause, not just a short phrase.
quests.explanation: 'Although' introduces a full clause here — 'despite' would instead need a noun phrase, like 'despite the slow line'.

quests.question: We upgraded to a bigger rental car ___ five of us were travelling together.
quests.hint: The number of travelers explains the upgrade.
quests.explanation: 'Because' gives the direct reason for a decision — the group size led to the upgrade.

quests.question: The ferry was cancelled due to strong winds, ___ we took the tunnel instead.
quests.hint: A cancellation directly led to an alternative choice.
quests.explanation: 'So' introduces a result — the cancelled ferry led to taking the tunnel.

quests.question: ___ demand for the product was higher than expected, the factory added a night shift.
quests.hint: This introduces a reason, similar to 'because', in a more formal tone.
quests.explanation: 'As' introduces a reason here — the high demand explains the added night shift.

quests.question: The committee will announce ___ the festival happens this year ___ it's postponed until spring.
quests.hint: Two possible outcomes are both still under consideration.
quests.explanation: 'Whether...or' introduces two possible outcomes under consideration — happening this year or being postponed.

quests.question: The negotiations were tense, ___ both sides eventually reached a fair agreement.
quests.hint: Difficulty is acknowledged, but the outcome was still positive.
quests.explanation: 'Though' introduces a concession — tense negotiations still led to a fair agreement.
